page.overview:
Who is Hei-Ran?

Hei-Ran had a daughter named Rangi who was first Yun's bodyguard and later the lover of Avatar Kyoshi. Hei-Ran worked with Jianzhu to locate her daughter and Kyoshi but was grievously poisoned by the earthbending master during the conclave of sages in Yokoya.

After recuperating in Agna Qel'a, Hei-Ran returned to the Fire Nation with her personal healer, Atuat, as well as her daughter Rangi. A victim of assassination attempts in Yun's quest for vengeance against the bending masters who had lied to him, Hei-Ran cut off her top-knot to display her dishonor. Although badly wounded in North Chung-Ling, she and Kyoshi deduced a possible connection between Yun and the Saowon clan, and she proposed a solution to prevent war in the Fire Nation.

Hei-Ran was a loyal ally of Avatar Kyoshi. As Rangi was in love with Kyoshi, Hei-Ran considered Kyoshi to be her own daughter and part of her family.

Born into the prestigious Sei'naka clan, later becoming a decorated military commander in the Fire Army serving in the infantry. Eventually, one of her relatives was assigned to be a chaperone of Avatar Kuruk, but the relative got sick at the last minute and sent Hei-Ran as a temporary replacement. As soon as Kuruk laid eyes on Hei-Ran, he was determined to make her a permanent companion and quickly declared his feelings for her. Hei-Ran immediately rejected Kuruk and claimed she had no interest in a relationship with the Avatar. However, she privately clarified that she would have no issue with an off-duty relationship. Eventually, she resigned her post to become a long-term companion of Kuruk.
